svg.title: Larimer County Chess Club
svg.desc: A circular green seal with the words LARIMER, COUNTY, CHESS and CLUB around the rim, separated by stars. Inside the rim, a winged chess knight stands behind a shield with an eight-by-eight chessboard. A Gordian knot arches above the knight. Talons grip an olive branch and an hourglass with half its sand fallen.

g.desc: Adapted from Celtic-knot-basic-linear.svg by AnonMoos and Erin Silversmith, Wikimedia Commons. The reference geometry is gently arched and recolored for the seal.
